must_do: run the read-only preflight: openspec list, read openspec/specs/<capability>/spec.md when present, and python3 shared/scripts/kmp_check.py --baseline
recognise 'build the dashboard feature' as a build-layer request and route to exactly one target: kmp-create-feature
state the missing-input case plainly when no OpenSpec spec exits, pointing at /opsx-propose, instead of inferring requirements
must_not: edit or create any file under feature/ (the guard blocks it without /tmp/.kmp-skill-active)
scaffold a feature module, run gradle, or start kmp-create-feature's work inside the router
route to two targets, or route a Phase 1 skill that does not exist yet (kmp-modify-feature and friends)

pass_criteria: One target named, zero mutations, zero feature/ writes; the preflight ran and the route matches the layer (build → kmp-create-feature, design → penpot-build-screen).
